title: Enhance sign in and session
body:
I wanted to get past most of the session management and authentication pieces with this PR as I find them to be the most challenging parts of this problem. I also dove in and wanted to cleanup any of the TODO's from the last PR. 

I'd love feedback on if the middle-ware approach for the API makes sense, and I'm not quite happy with how the front end checks for an authenticated user. I feel like there's a simpler implementation in there but I've been staring at it for to long and would love some extra eyes.

title: Initial authentication flow
body:
Provide basic login form and authentication mechanism over TLS. 

I decided to try and test the auth handler and login page exhaustively. I'm used to basically 100% test coverage so happy to add more but I didn't want to go overkill. Let me know if there are other files / cases you'd find interesting from a testing perspective.

I've added Todos to places I'd like to cleanup later, but felt this PR was already larger then I'd like so I wanted to get it over. It was difficult to find a reasonable stopping place and might have been better to start with a simpler feature.

title: Bootstrapping
body:
Setup of a simple react client and server with TLS.

I started to package a docker container as I hoped it would go fast, however ran into issue with the m1 chip on my laptop. I'll circle back to it at the end if there's time. 

Most of this commits are defaults that come with CRA and an extremely simple http server. I wanted to get the bootstrapping stuff out of the way so future PR's will be cleaner.
